descricao_produto: The product is a Hilee insulated stainless-steel water bottle with a built-in straw lid. It is a tall upright bottle, about three times taller than it is wide, with a smooth matte powder-coated body and a flat base. From top to bottom: (1) a rigid matte carry handle loop whose two ends pivot on small pins on the left and right sides of the lid, on the same axis as the flip cap hinge; (2) a flip cap hinged at the back of the lid: when closed it sits on top of the lid as a slanted wedge that rises toward the front and covers the drinking spout; when open it stands upright behind the spout and shows a rubber seal pad on its underside; (3) under the flip cap, a short drinking spout with an oval opening, and a small square latch button at the front edge of the lid; (4) a rounded dome-shaped lid; (5) a narrow ring band under the dome with the word HILEE embossed in the same color as the band, tone-on-tone and subtle; (6) the smooth plain body down to the base. The body has no print, no pattern, no paper sleeve and no label.
cor_preta: Colors of this unit (black, 946 ml): every part is matte black, the body, the dome lid, the ring band, the flip cap, the spout, the latch button and the carry handle; the only other tone is the dark-gray rubber seal pad under the flip cap. The body is a straight cylinder.
alca_preta: Carry handle in this video: folded down and seen as a small black loop at the left side of the lid, exactly as in the first frame; it never moves, never grows, never changes shape and never multiplies.

alca_roxa: Carry handle in this video: standing upright as an arch above the lid, exactly as in the first frame; it keeps its shape and its color and never multiplies.
angulo: Sai com voce: transporte (alca na tampa, 'facil de transportar', 'a prova de vazamentos' segundo o fabricante, tres tamanhos ate mais de um litro); vapor dourado no estudio grafite (intro), mao na alca no banco do parque (apresentacao), mao deslizando a garrafa na prateleira de travertino com cortina de voal (CTA)
angulo_reserva: Uma pra cada rotina (tres tamanhos e cores, preta e roxa lado a lado; risco de troca de cor)
Feita em camadas (aco inox 304, camada a vacuo, revestimento em po, facil de limpar; sem prova visual segura)
